title: Verdant Caldera: Roguelite Extraction

foundation.history: A forgotten hanging botanical lab once protected mineral terraces, until recurring geothermal plumes forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Amea Lark, a delver, must retrieve the endangered survey archive, relying on risk and retreat despite geothermal plumes.
central_conflict: a hostile salvage crew threatens the hanging botanical lab by restricting mineral terraces.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: geothermal plumes destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a hostile salvage crew contests access to mineral terraces
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The hanging botanical lab becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
